note: Task import now handles MS Project "Plan vs Actual" Excel exports cleanly: WBS codes no longer come in with float noise (4.1 instead of 4.0999999999999996), and predecessors written as MS Project task numbers (e.g. "2SS", "27SS", "124", "130SS+1 day") are now recognised and linked to the right task — the FS/SS/FF/SF relationship is kept (lag offsets are dropped). Classic WBS-code predecessors still work exactly as before.
